reviews.text:
My first appointment at this clinic was an emergency this morning for my cat Daisy, who had been very lethargic since last night, as my usual vet couldn't see me today.

I was seen by Dr. Le Calonnec, who was very gentle with Daisy, and her explanations were very clear and reassuring.
I'm delighted with this experience and highly recommend this clinic and this vet for her professionalism and kindness.

I highly recommend this clinic.
The veterinarians truly take the time to talk with owners, explain things, and answer our questions.
The veterinary assistants are also lovely and very professional.
The staff are warm and attentive; they take care of all the family's animals!

A caring and attentive team

I would like to thank the entire veterinary team for their kindness, professionalism, and support throughout my little Cocker Spaniel's surgery.
Every step was carefully monitored, and I was deeply touched by the kindness of the doctors and assistants. They took the time to answer my questions and reassure me.
A huge thank you to everyone for your support, availability, and compassion. Thanks to you, everything went smoothly, and I am incredibly grateful.
I highly recommend this team to all pet owners.

I'm giving one star today to draw attention to one particular person; this rating in no way reflects on the clinic as a whole.

My animals have been treated at this clinic for several years, and all the staff are extremely professional and caring, except for Dr. Marine Mathieu, who, as all the reviews mention, is extremely unpleasant and haughty.

My cat became extremely weak a few days ago. He's young and usually very active, but he kept lying on the floor and wasn't eating much. On Friday evening, we decided to take him to the vet, and he was "examined" by Dr. Matthieu. She told us his stomach was a little hard and that she wasn't sure what was wrong—perhaps pancreatitis, but nothing serious according to her. Despite his rather worrying condition, she didn't do any x-rays or anything. She sent him home with medication and told us that if he wasn't better, we should come back within 48 hours, so Monday morning, since they're closed on Sundays. After this half-hearted consultation, we were asked to pay €300. We wonder why, since, as mentioned earlier, there was no further examination, even though my cat wasn't well at that point. But oh well. On Sunday afternoon, we noticed his condition was deteriorating, so we rushed him to a supposedly excellent clinic. They told us it was lucky we came on our own initiative because if we had waited longer, as our dear vet had advised, he would have died. It turned out he had ingested a foreign object, a piece of fabric, something that would have been immediately apparent if an X-ray/ultrasound had been done at the very first appointment. So, thank you to Ms. Matthieu for her lack of professionalism. When I went to pick up my cat, she had the nerve to tell me, "It wasn't me who made him ingest that piece of fabric." I find it unacceptable to respond like that when I almost lost my cat. And then, no compensation or goodwill gesture was offered following her error in judgment. In short, if you make an appointment there, go ahead, but definitely avoid this woman. It's no coincidence that she has so many bad reviews and that she's the only one. If we had looked beforehand, we never would have made an appointment with her.

The vet who saw me is afraid of dogs.
She called my dog ​​aggressive when he was simply anxious about the visit.
I've never seen anything like it at a veterinary clinic.
Vetes who are afraid of dogs!
She then yelled at me like a madwoman, with absolutely no respect.
We pay to be insulted.
I will never go back to that clinic.
Top-notch veterinary clinic. They take in sturdy animals and it's clear they love them. Thank you. 🙏🏼 …

The reception staff are great. However, the same cannot be said for the racist vet who is condescending if you're not of French or European origin... Indeed, the interaction with the vet is different depending on your background... My wife, who is French, brought our kitten in for its first vaccination, and everything went well. The vet vaccinated our cat, and then my wife paid for the consultation. She wasn't available for the booster shot; I had to bring our kitten in for the booster. The vet first ushered people ahead of me without any explanation. Then she greeted me coldly, looked me up and down, and asked me to pay before even attending to my cat. Once the bill was paid, she quickly gave our cat the injection without really examining it and told me to leave her office immediately.

The staff is very friendly. The vet I saw immediately understood the problems I was having with my pet, without judgment, and prescribed treatment. This is so refreshing after being told for ages "you need to train him" when the problem goes much deeper. It's a veterinary clinic I would recommend without hesitation!

A warm and attentive welcome. I highly recommend this veterinary clinic if you have a pet that needs treatment. They treat all my animals, and frankly, they always do excellent work. I can't thank them enough because they've always been there whenever I've had a question or concern about my animals. And the veterinarians themselves are truly top-notch.
No complaints about the rest of the clinic, but Dr. Mathieu is unpleasant and haughty.

A fantastic veterinary clinic that I wholeheartedly recommend!

The entire team is truly amazing: you can tell they genuinely love animals and do everything they can for their well-being.
I regularly see Dr. Rault and Dr. Mathieu, who are excellent professionals, very attentive, and also incredibly kind.
The veterinary assistants are also wonderful, always welcoming, and very dedicated to their work.
A huge thank you as well to Mathilde and Sophie for their invaluable help while they were looking after my cat—they were simply amazing!
Thank you to the whole team for your commitment and kindness 💛
My cat has diabetes. The blood and urine tests the vet did were very useful. They also did an ultrasound. The vet was very professional.
Terrible reception, extremely unpleasant and arrogant veterinarian who uses completely inappropriate language with clients; never again, avoid at all costs!!!

went there for I-CAD registration and pet passport for my cat the following week after I arrived from USA.(first time to go to vet in France!)

All staff here and Dr.Calonnec are very welcoming, very kind, professional and helped me so much (I'm just arrived and don't even speak French and don't know system etc but all staff spoke very good English and helped me very kindly and professionally)

On top of that, convenient location near everything and clinic is very clean and welcoming atmoshere.

Strongly recommended (for locals and someone just arrived like me)

Merci beaucoup encore for all staff and Dr.Calonnec!!!
Took Rio in for his vaccination today, great experience! The vet is really cool and very kind, Rio was in good hands 🐾 I recommend him! …
Dr. Tulasne has been treating my cat since he was a kitten, and she's very professional. Thank you to her and the whole team for their professionalism and kindness.
Excellent and very attentive vet. Always on time, which is much appreciated, and gives excellent advice. You can tell your pets are in good hands. I highly recommend!

The staff there gave me great advice, especially since I adopted a cat for the first time seven years ago. I was a complete novice; Sacha had been found in the street. They guided me through his daily care, even though he was incredibly resistant. Now, they're explaining how not to be fooled by his acting skills when it comes to getting his food.
Good evening, veterinarians.

My cats have been patients at this clinic for over two years. The reception staff and the veterinarians are all very friendly and attentive. My cat had a health issue in early 2024, and the team did everything possible to get me an emergency appointment within the hour, arranged for an ultrasound machine to be brought in, and was able to treat my cat as quickly as possible.
I am very grateful for their responsiveness; without it, my cat might not be here anymore, and I will continue to take my animals to this clinic as long as I live in the area!
Thank you for your welcome and professionalism.

Thank you to the veterinary team at the Olympiades clinic, and especially to Dr. Tulasne. They took excellent care of my dog ​​Fifty until his very last moments. His diagnoses were always accurate and precise, and his support was incredibly kind. It's reassuring to know you'll be there for my next dog!
Excellent advice provided following several accidents my dog ​​suffered. Attentive and caring follow-up for the animal. Highly recommended.

I have been going to the clinic for 6 years, and the staff is knowledable and pleasent. My French is awful, but the staff always makes me comfortable and speaks English. Their pricing is correct and fair.
Dr Tulasne often checks up on my dog and goes above and beyond of what you would expect from a veterinary clinic. I could not ask for a better vet.
I highly recommend this clinic, both for the care provided and the kindness of the team. Very satisfied.

My little Yorkie received so much care and gentleness; she was pampered and cuddled from the moment she arrived. Very rarely, going to the vet no longer seems like a chore for her!
Thank you for your care!
Dr. Rault is mediocre and should be avoided.

I came in for my cat who was suffering from feline gastroenteritis, and I received a very poor reception. I put up with it for my cat's sake, but despite that, I was spoken to rudely from beginning to end. I did not appreciate the way I was treated at all. I absolutely do not recommend this place!
Terrible welcome, aggressive tone, no consideration for the customer. I've never seen a professional speak like that. A completely unacceptable experience.

Avoid at all costs! The vet spoke to me incredibly rudely for no reason, tore up a treatment sheet right in front of me—a total lack of respect. She provoked me and even told me to leave a bad review on Google and that she didn't care when I simply said, "You don't treat clients like that." What's more, she had the nerve to grab my arm, drag me out of her vet's office, and slam the door in my face!

I can't recommend this clinic highly enough! 🙏 They literally saved my 8-year-old cat's life. After a terrible experience at another clinic, I was really stressed, but the vet reassured me right from the start. She was incredibly gentle and kind, taking the time to explain everything to me.
Thanks to her, my cat is doing so much better now 💕
I've known this veterinary clinic for a long time. I really appreciate Dr. Rault, who treats Saffran.
Caring veterinarians, I recommend them
Excellent clinic, I highly recommend it!
Excellent care provided by a welcoming, professional and very patient veterinarian with a cat that was not easy to treat.
Thank you to Justine for being with me during my cat's final moments. My best wishes to everyone!

Excellent veterinary clinic! My cat is a patient there, and I've always been very satisfied. The team is professional, attentive, and truly caring with the animals. You can tell they love their work and do everything for the well-being of our companions. I highly recommend them!

I don't understand the ratings, which is precisely why I entrusted my animals to this clinic. I saw three or four different vets there, and it was appalling. My dog ​​suffered for six months from a digestive issue that caused nighttime diarrhea. I took him to the clinic for six months, only to be sold Forti Flora and Pro Plan probiotics each time, which were NEVER effective. No matter how much I told them, they continued to sell me this powder without ever conducting any further tests. It only took ONE appointment, just ONE, with my family vet 300 km away, to get it resolved in one go, because at least they went further and provided me with the best possible care.

Even worse, I entrusted my cat to them, and I ended up with a vet who had the nerve to tell me, "Be careful, your family vet forgot to vaccinate your cat against feline leukemia. The annual vaccination was missed, you'll have to tell them, it's serious." She pointed to the sticker, and I saw an L. I deduced that it meant Feline Leukemia, something she insisted on, maintaining that my cat wasn't up-to-date on its vaccinations, then added, laughing, "But don't tell them I said that, otherwise they'll think I don't know my job, hahahaha." How embarrassing. Even I, who didn't spend all those years studying veterinary medicine, understood that L meant Feline Leukemia.
The fact that she added that comment shows how little she knows about her profession, and it's worrying to entrust your pet to this kind of person. In six months of numerous visits to them, they have NEVER done anything good for my two animals. That was the last straw. Not to mention that this clinic told me my cat didn't have a heart murmur, even though she's been monitored for it for six years. In short, a disaster. I'd rather drive 300km back than go to a clinic in Paris that partners with FortiFlora.
